description.p: The GNU portability library is a macro system and C declarations and definitions for commonly-used API elements and abstracted system behaviors. It can be used to improve portability and other functionality in your programs.

This package has the repository of gnulib as a git bundle, not an unpacked source tree. Packages that use gnulib clone it and check out the commit they pin, and gnulib-patch applies the fixes of this package to the clone.
